results.title: Naval Police reviews waterway security ahead of Durga Puja
results.description: Naval Police has stepped up security for Durga Puja, reviewing arrangements for puja mandaps, river routes and ferry ghats and planning stronger patrols and round-the-clock monitoring during the celebrations. Naval Police Additional Inspector General Md Rezaul Karim chaired a meeting at the Dhaka headquarters to assess preparations for peaceful celebrations and safe idol immersion, according to the press release.
